name: polyv-live
description: Manage PolyV live streaming services via the polyv-live-cli: channels, stream keys and status, playbacks, products, coupons, sessions, chat, viewers, watch conditions, platform settings and live statistics.

description_en: Manage PolyV live streaming services via the polyv-live-cli: channels, stream keys and status, playbacks, products, coupons, sessions, chat, viewers, watch conditions, platform settings and live statistics.
examples_zh: 看看我现在的直播频道和状态
